availability.note: No UK product information for a fixed-dose cetirizine/pseudoephedrine tablet. Searched 2026-10-17: emc (medicines.org.uk) by the clinic trade name and by ingredient combination: no results; MHRA Products index: no SPC, PIL or PAR with this combination (all cetirizine documents list cetirizine alone; no pseudoephedrine document lists cetirizine). Not filled from non-UK labels. The only content shown is MHRA Drug Safety Update advice (20 Feb 2024) that applies to all pseudoephedrine-containing medicines, and SPS/BUMPS advice on decongestants in pregnancy; no engine rules (no-uk-product). Each ingredient alone has UK SmPCs (see the single-ingredient medicine).

formulations.label: Tablets, cetirizine 5 mg + pseudoephedrine 120 mg (clinic product)

bnf.note: BNF/BNFC is only available in the UK; not accessed.

items.t: MHRA advice for all pseudoephedrine-containing medicines (not a product label): contraindicated in severe or uncontrolled hypertension, or severe renal disease.

src.q: use of the product is contraindicated in patients with severe hypertension or uncontrolled hypertension, or severe renal disease

items.t: MHRA: pseudoephedrine is for short-term use only, not for prolonged use. PRES/RCVS risk is very rare.

src.q: pseudoephedrine is for short term use only and should not be used for prolonged or extended use
PRES and RCVS are recognised very rare side effects with pseudoephedrine-containing medicines

items.t: MHRA: pseudoephedrine is contraindicated in severe renal disease (no measure or threshold stated).

src.q: use of the product is contraindicated in patients with severe hypertension or uncontrolled hypertension, or severe renal disease

items.t: SPS: decongestants are not recommended at any stage of pregnancy (may reduce placental blood flow). BUMPS: decongestant tablets should be avoided in pregnancy.

src.q: Decongestants are not recommended for use at any stage of pregnancy as they could reduce blood flow in the placenta and to the baby.
Ibuprofen and decongestant nasal spray, drops or tablets should be avoided in pregnancy.

items.t: PRES and RCVS (very rare): sudden severe or thunderclap headache, sudden nausea and vomiting, confusion, seizures or visual disturbance. Stop immediately and seek urgent medical attention.

src.q: PRES and RCVS present with the following symptoms: sudden severe headache or thunderclap headache, sudden onset of nausea and vomiting, confusion, seizures and/or visual disturbances
to stop the medication immediately and to seek urgent medical attention if these occur

items.t: Do not take pseudoephedrine with very high blood pressure, blood pressure not controlled by medicines, or severe kidney disease. Stop and get urgent help for a sudden severe headache, vomiting, confusion, seizures or vision changes.

src.q: do not take pseudoephedrine if you have very high blood pressure (hypertension) or hypertension not controlled by your medicines
do not take pseudoephedrine if you have severe acute (sudden) or chronic (long-term) kidney disease or kidney failure
then stop taking the medicine immediately and seek urgent medical attention
